jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, China & APAC
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. jobs.title: Team Lead
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. THE ROLE We are hiring a Team Lead, Web3 to lead a cross-functional team of frontend, backend, smart contract and QA engineers in XsollaZK, Xsolla's Web3 ecosystem on a zkSync-based L2. Your team builds: smart wallets built on account abstraction; SDKs that game studios and partners use to bring players on-chain; infrastructure backend services for tokenizing in-game items and currencies; ecosystem dApps: a DEX, an NFT marketplace and an auction. This is a management role. Most of your time goes to people and delivery: building the team, growing engineers, and making delivery predictable. The rest goes to technical leadership: architecture, reviews and hands-on code where it matters.

jobs.title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
jobs.description_text: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli card
